classification.rationale: Transcript of an interview/conversation between Robert Bigelow and George Knapp discussing UFO disclosure, Bigelow's meeting with President Trump, and historical UFO cases. Contains elements of witness testimony and media interview.

content_assessment.source_provenance: Transcript of a recorded interview (optional context: https://youtu.be/q0N33jb7Bhk). Speaker identified as Robert Bigelow based on contextual clues (AATIP, Skinwalker Ranch, DIA clearance).
content_assessment.redaction_ocr_risk: Transcript includes speech disfluencies ([clears throat], [snorts], [music]). No major redactions or illegible spans noted.
content_assessment.duplicate_recycling: Contains references to well-known historical cases (Roswell, Phoenix Lights, Belgian UFO wave) but frames them within a new first-hand account of a presidential briefing.
follow_up_needed: Verify the date of the Oval Office meeting (stated as Jan- or February 6th) and attendees (William Scharf, Susie Wiles) against White House visitor logs or official schedules.
Cross-reference Bigelow's account of Harry Reid's conversation with Bill Clinton against Reid's memoir or other public statements.
Verify the existence and scope of the AATIP/BAS program under DIA and Bigelow's specific role and clearance level.

I think Bush senior knew quite a bit because he was a head of CIA. I think Nixon did. I think Eisenhower did.

I related conversations I have had with General De Brouwer who was a chief of the Air Force for Belgium and there was a very interesting flap that it was about 18 months long with triangle triangular craft.

They will not know anything about unacknowledged SAPs, for sure. And only on a really serious need-to-know basis would they have anything to do with acknowledged SAPs.
We have no ability to control anything [regarding UAPs]. We haven't been in control of anything, ever, for this 80 years of modern history.
key_findings: Meeting date stated as Jan- or February 6th during the Trump administration.
Meeting attendees: Robert Bigelow, President Trump, William Scharf (Staff Secretary), Susie Wiles (mentioned as advising Bigelow).
Bigelow presented 7 reports to the President, one specifically on UAP/ET/disclosure.
Bigelow states he held TS/SCI clearance for the AATIP/BAS program under DIA.
Bigelow references unacknowledged Special Access Programs (SAPs) and claims presidents are not entitled to know about them.
Historical figures mentioned in relation to UFO knowledge: Harry Reid, Bill Clinton, George H.W. Bush, Richard Nixon, Dwight Eisenhower.
Bigelow describes 'gatekeepers' in government and private corporations who hold custody of UFO/ET information and hardware.
supporting_evidence: Bigelow cites Harry Reid's direct interaction with Bill Clinton regarding Clinton's interest in UFOs and JFK.
Bigelow cites Sappho Henderson's account of her husband Pappy Henderson's role in the Roswell crash retrieval.
Bigelow cites General De Brouwer's account of the Belgian UFO wave.
Bigelow cites Fife Symington's witness status during the Phoenix Lights.
contradictory_evidence: Bigelow states Clinton didn't know about the subject, but also says 'I think Bush senior knew quite a bit... I think Nixon did. I think Eisenhower did,' indicating varying levels of presidential knowledge across administrations.
